limits: No character level, equipment, skill rank, wallet or reward grants. All progression is earned through actual commands and verified World kills.
Virtual server Date plus isolated already-confirmed camp cooldown aging accelerate waiting. Navigation between encounters and recovery are charged estimates, not GUI timing.
Individual camp encounters exclude overlapping neighbouring fights. This is an optimistic route bound, not a sustainable unattended farming measurement.

The task calendar attempts reachable offered tasks; unsupported or unfinished steps remain visible. It cannot be called all-tasks completion unless recorded done IDs actually cover the authored calendar.
